name: Going Up?
source:
Story about a survivor forced into an unconventional job when the realm they work in falls into chaos.

With a mysterious sickness, unknown corruption, and gods in panic, who lives or dies is in your hands. The elevator is your only safe space.

One wrong move means death in the domain of love.

[From [url=https://kardiadust.itch.io/going-up]Itch.io[/url]]
